author: TokenJunkieLabs
purpose: Derived functional interface projection for the Leap device-interval product.

projection.basis: Current first-party endpoint OpenAPI blocks and original CSV/device guides.
projection.required_lists: Preserved exactly, including the two explicit inconsistencies recorded below.

authentication.credential: Existing Leap API key for the selected environment
authentication.note: The primary authentication guide permits API keys directly; the OpenAPI bearerFormat label does not require exchanging an API key for a JWT.

region.provider_validation: REG_0003 also checks that the region is a valid state.

net.signed_net_interpretation: Signed net is consistent with the stated subtraction equation; a separate sign range is not specified.

numeric_rules.precision_or_equality_tolerance: Not specified in the retrieved contract.

time_rules.maximum_age_arithmetic: The guide states two years without specifying calendar versus fixed-day arithmetic.

product_scope.source_note: The general meter guide describes some partner-created UTILITY_METER programs. DEVICE-only is this product's narrower scope; it is not a claim that all partner-created utility meters are globally unsupported.

meter_verification.source_note: Retain explicit original partner evidence for historical custody; creation time and creator do not establish the owner at each interval.

uploads.bounds_source: The parameter description states 1–500; its schema omits bounds.

pagination.token_semantics: A next_page_token may indicate more records; follow the exact opaque value until absent.

original_file.source_inconsistency: The page summary mentions filtering error lines, but the operation declares only job_id.

application_decisions: Retain the exact submitted bytes and all response evidence before any new request.
An unknown upload outcome stays unresolved until provider evidence identifies its job.
Compare complete original-file bytes when adopting a candidate job; do not treat a matching timestamp, filename or limited preview alone as proof.
Do not forward the Leap API Authorization header to a signed file-download URL.
Preserve each original last_job_id and original/current path separately.

missing_statuses.PENDING: Already submitted and processing; no further submission is called for.

recovery.later_processing_max_in_guide: The accepted-file guide says subsequent processing may take up to one day.

schema_inconsistencies.handling: Retain the actual response and error_summary. Do not synthesize an undocumented summary value or discard a useful response solely because this required list is inconsistent.
Retain rows with the documented line/column/code/message properties; preserve the inconsistent original schema for provenance.

schema_inconsistencies.conflict: Guide says positive; original example includes zero; error-code descriptions identify negative values as invalid.
schema_inconsistencies.handling: Make the chosen zero handling explicit and retain original numeric values.

schema_inconsistencies.conflict: Current OpenAPI enums use uppercase UTILITY_METER and DEVICE; narrative guide uses lower-case names.
schema_inconsistencies.handling: Use the exact current OpenAPI wire enum.
